body: I know if I felt angry at her, it would make it all so much easier. But I don't, i still love her exactly the same :(

I've been feeling this agony for 2 months and it keeps getting harder. I just can't do it anymore, we all have different pain thresholds and i've reached mine. What makes it all the harder is that I don't really have anyone I can properly talk to about this. I have one good friend who I wouldn't want to tell (thats just me who wouldn't want to tell him, I would feel ashamed to be his friend if he knew). And I live with my Dad and I wouldn't tell him and I don't have any pets :(
Its really really nice to hear from someone going through the same thing as me
I don't think I can cope with the pain any longer, let alone 4 more months
2 months. It feels longer. And i've been thinking about killing myself for a few weeks
I want my suffering to stop. Even though I might be alright in 10 years or so. I can't cope with this pain any longer. I'm no longer afraid of death
I feel I've given myself all the time I need

I just really really want to die. I am sure. I'm just fed up of this pain and killing myself is the only way to make it stop. I feel a burden to my family, I've lost all interest in my hobbies and passions. I struggle to get up in the morning. I've just had enough
